bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
base=b44c2d73d4e7acbd00ed4f96c41c2fedeb494c4c
head=8e35800be335a61d8910b066d2130a05a8dcf9a8
release="$root/.releases/$head/video-dualmode-three-way-stage"
test -d "$repo/.git" && test -f "$root/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 31
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 32
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin feat/video-paidmedia-invoice-dual-mode-20261124 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 33
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 34
test ! -e "$release" || exit 35
mkdir -p "$release/live" "$release/base" "$release/new" "$release/merged"
mask=0
bit=1
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs;do
 mkdir -p "$release/live/$(dirname "$p")" "$release/base/$(dirname "$p")" "$release/new/$(dirname "$p")" "$release/merged/$(dirname "$p")"
 docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$p" "$release/live/$p" >/dev/null || exit 36
 git -C "$repo" show "$base:$p" > "$release/base/$p" || exit 37
 git -C "$repo" show "$head:$p" > "$release/new/$p" || exit 38
 rc=0
 git merge-file -p -L LIVE -L BASE -L PR8 "$release/live/$p" "$release/base/$p" "$release/new/$p" > "$release/merged/$p" || rc=$?
 if test "$rc" -gt 0;then mask=$((mask+bit));fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
for p in src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs sql/022_video_invoice_fallback.sql;do
 mkdir -p "$release/merged/$(dirname "$p")"
 git -C "$repo" show "$head:$p" > "$release/merged/$p" || exit 39
done
exit $((100+mask))
